items.title: WMS students in Mrs. Baker’s Science class kicked off their unit on states of matter and physical and chemical changes…
items.excerpt: with a delicious hands-on lesson, making fudge!🍫 Students identified solids and liquids, then tracked how the ingredients changed from their original state to being heated and finally cooled. They recorded their observations in charts, connecting classroom concepts to a real-world experiment.…
